title: Brazilian Grilled Mozzarella Skewers with Herbal Butter
description: A fusion of Brazilian flavors with mozzarella cheese, grilled to perfection and served with a side of herbal butter. A perfect snack or appetizer for any occasion.

ingredients.name: Brazilian spices (e.g. malagueta peppers)
ingredients.notes: adjust according to desired heat level

instructions: 2. Cut the mozzarella cheese into 1-inch cubes.
3. Thread the cheese cubes onto the jazzy skewers.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the herbal butter ingredients (see notes).
5. Brush the herbal butter mixture onto both sides of the cheese cubes.
6. Season with Brazilian spices to taste.
7. Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and slightly charred.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
